development_data: Consumed synthetic worlds only, including AT1 fresh worlds after AT1 result finalization.
candidate_family: At each sequential step mix PL(score/2.0) with uniform choice probability: P=(1-eps)*P_T2+eps*Uniform.

selected_candidate.definition: 0.95 * P_T2 + 0.05 * Uniform at each sequential choice step

interpretation: A small explicit contamination channel improved both mean and maximum regret on consumed worlds dominated by unobserved positive shocks. Candidate remains synthetic-development-only until a fresh preregistered battery passes independently.
